title: Are Large Language Models Consistent over Value-laden Questions?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the consistency of model stances (support vs. oppose) on over 300 value-laden, controversial, and uncontroversial topics (e.g., euthanasia, abortion, gun control) using Jensen-Shannon divergence across paraphrased questions, related topical questions, and different use-cases (multiple-choice vs. open-ended generation).

Assessing multilingual and cross-cultural consistency by comparing model responses to country-specific topics (tailored to the U.S., China, Germany, and Japan) translated into English, Chinese, German, and Japanese.

Measuring the frequency of 'yes' or affirmative answers across multiple-choice questions to identify if models exhibit a baseline 'yes' bias regardless of whether the affirmative answer indicates support or opposition to the underlying topic.
